purpose: Build one deterministic, auditable trial-level data layer shared by later experiments; no model selection or OCF tuning occurs here.

cache.array_layout: one trial per row; flattened unit-major unit x time counts; uint16 NPY memmaps
cache.shared_content: raw deterministic counts, target IDs only for train, sample/trial mappings, sample IDs, mouse/session/task metadata, source and count hashes
cache.excluded_content: normalization statistics, PCA, class prototypes, model weights, validation-derived parameters, hidden labels

required_real_data_checks.count_equality: Cached counts must exactly equal src.features.trial_count_features for every train block and every cached bin width.

split_manifests.checks: Every trial appears exactly once across train/validation within each block; zero trial overlap; Task1 zero target overlap; Task2 complete held-out day; Task3 exactly three train and one validation trial for every glyph in every block.
split_manifests.round_trip: Save and reload explicit indices, then require exact equality with freshly generated frozen splits.

completion_gate: All real-data checks and split checks pass. No OCF is computed and no production pipeline is changed by this experiment.
